first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A crouching, moving person carrying a round shield and longbow, wearing a dark top, a light gray-white hanging cloth, and a long yellow-ochre cloth strip.

entities.name: stone passageway
entities.identification: The light-colored elevated walkable stone surface under Person A's feet and in front of the distant gateposts.

entities.name: cage brazier
entities.identification: The group of black cage braziers beside the passageway, distinguished by their positions at the nearby fence corner and beside the distant section of parapet wall.

entities.name: wooden stake fence
entities.identification: A fence formed by densely arranged, slender gray-brown wooden stakes, with horizontal rails and some diagonal braces.

entities.name: wood-roofed courtyard
entities.identification: The low courtyard behind the fence, with orange-brown covering panels on its wooden-pole roof.

entities.name: tower-wall complex
entities.identification: The distant complex composed of a reddish-brown tower, a long wall, square gateposts, and an open framework above.

entities.name: layered rock face
entities.identification: The light ochre to reddish-brown, horizontally layered rock face with an uneven outline in the upper-left distance.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light gray-white to light yellow-gray sky visible between the buildings, tree canopies, and rock face.

entities.name: vegetation
entities.identification: The yellow-green grasses and shrubs, broad-canopied trees, palms, and other plants outside the passageway.

entities.name: sandy ground
entities.identification: The exposed light yellow-brown ground below and outside the elevated passageway, excluding the stone surface under Person A's feet.

entities.name: domed stone parapet wall
entities.identification: The thick, light-colored stone parapet wall along the passageway, with repeated arched top blocks whose front faces have recessed borders and pale red marks.

entities.name: longbow
entities.identification: The slender, curved yellow-brown bow attached to Person A's back, with both ends exposed.

entities.name: round shield
entities.identification: The dark green-black shield on Person A's back, with light-colored decoration on its surface and a flattened oval projection when viewed obliquely.

entities.name: woven mat
entities.identification: Light-brown woven pieces scattered across the stone surface, with some loose edges.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The gray-brown horse beside the wooden shelter in front of the long wall; part of it appears at the extreme right edge starting at frame 66, and its head, neck, and parts of its legs are visible at frame 68, while the rest of its body is cropped by the frame boundary.
